versions.changelog:
point-figure 0.1.0

- Initial release introducing core logic and execution steps for point-and-figure (P&F, X/O columns) charting, including three-point reversal and horizontal count method.
- Clear criteria and guide for when to use/not use this skill, with distinctions versus candle/line charts and trendline tools.
- Includes practical examples (e.g., parameter selection for Swiss Franc and cotton) and actionable workflow for identifying support/resistance and calculating price targets.
- Emphasizes strict signal discipline and the importance of stop losses per source material.
- Includes comprehensive methodology, boundaries, and testing/audit record.
